subject: Azure offer: SPN handshake, SKU mapping, and co-sell entitlement questions
messages:
From: Priya Menon <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure offer: SPN handshake, SKU mapping, and co-sell entitlement questions

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for starting the Azure Marketplace intake for StellarData. I pulled together the minimal items our validation team needs before we schedule the technical gate review: a SKU-to-Plan mapping (CSV), the Service Principal (SPN) you plan to use for onboarding (with required permissions), and confirmation of co-sell intent so we can enable the appropriate marketplace entitlements.

Quick checklist (attached guidance in the marketplace seller portal):
- SKU mapping: SKU ID, display name, unit type (monthly seat / consumption), and pricing tier
- SPN permissions: Owner or Contributor on the Publisher Resource Group + Reader on subscriptions referenced by the offer
- Co-sell: is this available for marketplace co-sell (yes/no) and lead-sharing contact

Two clarification asks before the tech validation call:
1) Are you planning to use one SKU with multiple tiers or separate SKUs per tier?
2) Will the offer call any external endpoints that require inbound network proofs (we sometimes need outbound IP allowlist details)?

I can run the validation once you share the CSV and SPN service principal details. If it helps, we can book a 30-min pre-check this week.

Attachments referenced: marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf (guidance), sample-sku-template.csv

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Azure Marketplace Specialist
Microsoft Corporation

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure offer: SPN handshake, SKU mapping, and co-sell entitlement questions

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Irene (infra lead) and Marissa (go-to-market) so we can get you everything you need.

Answers up front: 
- SKU approach: we plan separate SKUs per tier (FreeTrial, Standard, Enterprise) to keep billing and telemetry isolated. I attached our draft CSV (sku-mapping-draft.csv).
- SPN: we'll create a dedicated SPN for publishing. Per our security practice we prefer Contributor on the Publisher Resource Group only; we included a screenshot of the SPN roles we propose (spn-permissions-screenshot.png). If Owner is mandatory for any portal tasks, let us know precisely which actions require Owner.
- Network calls: the runtime reaches out to our telemetry ingestion endpoint (https://telemetry.stellardata.com) and to a CDN for model artifacts. We do not require inbound firewall openings for validation; however if Nexus requires outbound IP ranges we can provide them.

Open items / asks for you: 
1) Confirm whether Contributor on the Publisher RG suffices for validation steps (or list Owner-only tasks).
2) Provide the preferred HubSpot deal link or DocuSign flow for the publisher agreement so procurement at StellarData can review.

We'd like to get the tech validation scheduled next week (preferably 30-min). Proposed times: Thu 24 Jul 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 25 Jul 09:00–09:30 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure offer: SPN handshake, SKU mapping, and co-sell entitlement questions

Karthik / Irene — quick note from GTM: StellarData confirmed they want co-sell enabled and will accept marketplace invoicing (no upfront enterprise contract required).

Action items for infra before we book Priya's slot:
- Irene: please validate the SPN can be assigned Contributor on the Publisher RG and provide a short README of steps we give Priya for portal tasks that may need Owner.
- Karthik: once Irene confirms, I will send Priya the HubSpot deal link and list the lead-share contact from StellarData (procurement@stellardata.com).

One-liner: yes to separate SKUs per tier. Keeping telemetry calls outbound only.

-Marissa
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Menon <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: StellarData <procurement@stellardata.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure offer: SPN handshake, SKU mapping, and co-sell entitlement questions

Thanks for the quick turnaround — clear and helpful.

Short answers:
- Contributor on Publisher RG is sufficient for the validation steps we run (artifact upload, test deploy). Only a small set of portal operations (manifest-level rotation) require Owner; we can perform those jointly with your SPN or use an alternate Owner account.
- Co-sell: noted, I've enabled the entitlement in our tooling and invited procurement@stellardata.com to the intake.

Next steps I scheduled for you:
- Technical validation call: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:00 PT (invite sent) — 30 minutes (Teams link in calendar invite)
- DocuSign publisher agreement: https://docusign.microsoft.com/r/abc123 (StellarData procurement already cc'd)

I've attached a short validation checklist and added a reviewer note on the HubSpot deal. If anything changes, reply to this thread and we'll adjust.

Regards,
Priya Menon
Azure Marketplace Specialist
Microsoft Corporation
